principle: Descriptive thickness, structural capacity, known-truth method states and empirically transferable axis-resolved species states are distinct handoff objects and must not be relabeled as one another.

handoff_categories.empirical_axis_resolved_supported: May be passed to N3 as an empirically supported axis-resolved species state under the frozen N2 semantics.
handoff_categories.known_truth_method_state_only: May be passed only for synthetic/known-truth method testing, not as empirical species evidence.
handoff_categories.descriptive_projection_only: May retain N2 thickness/projection summaries, but the local axis-resolved organization must not be used as an empirical N3 species-state map.
handoff_categories.structural_capacity_only: May retain structural state-space capacity under its declared semantics, but it must not be relabeled as species use/support.
handoff_categories.unavailable: No axis-resolved handoff object is supported under the declared N2 boundary.
